defect: Concurrent automation could consume a one-use rule more than once before persisted use count changed.
scenario: Two pending requests and one maximumUses=1 rule enter the automation microtasks together; both previously observed uses=0 and both sent accepted responses.
evidence: Regression test test/interaction.test.ts:470-497 passes with runtime.calls length 1, rule uses 1, second interaction pending.
fix: Reserve rule uses before provider dispatch and release the reservation on completion.

defect: A replayed response event could carry publicData while marked secret.
scenario: A persisted interaction.response.requested event sets containsSecret=true and publicData={token:...}; reduction previously accepted the value into the event journal path.
evidence: Regression test test/reducer.test.ts:63-113 rejects the event with Secret interaction responses cannot contain public data.
fix: Reject secret response events before state reduction; main Braid reducer has the same check.

defect: A provider whose capabilities omit every offered permission scope still showed an enabled response action.
scenario: A permission request offers allow_session while capabilities expose only once; the view previously reported canRespond=true and only the controller rejected later.
evidence: Regression test test/interaction.test.ts:134-153 asserts canRespond=false and a plain permission-scope message.
fix: Disable response when no offered permission scope is supported.

defect: Non-finite numeric values were accepted by the manual validator despite the canonical data contract.
scenario: A programmatic provider submits number=NaN; typeof was number, so state and digest handling could receive a non-finite value.
fix: Require finite numbers before canonical answer validation.
